Implementation Plan

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends review_conflict_prepare.sh folded-fragment keep and .ai asset take-base rules
Scope-mode justification: Phase 4 (R2b) of `docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md` is delivered in full and nothing else. That covers the deterministic take-base pre-step, posting the dropped edit on the PR, stage context for the paths the model still gets, and the in-loop `unmerged_left` retry, all behind `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED`. The plan's file list leaves out one thing the issue requires. Without the two-line `env:` forward in `review_autofix.yml`, the documented rollback ("set the repository variable to false") would not reach the scripts. Phase 3 (#9842) added the same kind of forward for `RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_CHECK_ENABLED`, so this follows existing practice. The explicit-keep declaration (D3) adds about 20 lines over the shortcut. Without it, the "keep" half of the plan's instruction cannot be expressed on the source repo, and the in-loop retry would only turn a keep decision into a slower failure. §6 order (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed) puts correctness first, so the complete option wins under Boil the Lake. No new dependency, workflow job or external interface.

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-9650` @ `52480ebf293d354b356cfe8789fd39df0a10e9dc` (integration branch mismatch: false). Phase 3 (#9842, PR #9843) is already on this ref: `_verify_resolution_provenance` and `RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_CHECK_ENABLED` are in `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`.

## Automation (§20.E)
- No new script. This extends `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` (the "Prepare merge-conflict resolver prompt and pre-snapshot" step) and `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` (the "Run Codex resolver, validate, stage, commit" step) in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`. Both are triggered by review_autofix runs on PRs with merge conflicts.
- No new job or workflow, no supervisor, no DB work, no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry. Jobs per triggering event are unchanged.

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`: deterministic non-fragment modify/delete take-base
Add a self-contained block delimited by `# >>> non-fragment modify/delete take-base` / `# <<< non-fragment modify/delete take-base`. It goes right after the folded-fragment block (after its closing `fi`, around :597) and before `# >>> .ai/ validation asset take-base`.
- **Switch:** `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED`, parsed like `CONFLICT_AI_ASSET_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED`: unset, empty or `true` (any case) means on; `false` means off; any other value means off with a `::warning::`.
- **Changed-line cap:** script-only `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_MAX_CHANGED_LINES`, default `20`, integer clamped to 1..200. An invalid value falls back to 20 with a warning.
- **When it runs:** only when `_resolver_allowlist_count > 0` and `MERGE_HEAD` resolves. Then `_mdd_merge_base="$(git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD)"`; if that is empty, log `reason=no_merge_base` and skip.
- **Per allowlist path:** process only paths with `git ls-files -u` stages exactly `1 2`, i.e. the PR modified the file and the base deleted it. Skip:
  - `changelog.d/*`, `agents.d/*`, `.ai/*`, `.gitleaksignore` and `${MANIFEST_UNION_PATH}`. Those belong to the folded-fragment, .ai asset, gitleaks and manifest rules; the literal `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` is used if the variable is not yet defined at this point.
  - Any path whose stage-2 mode is not `100644`/`100755` (`reason=not_regular`), or whose worktree entry is a symlink.
- **Find the deleting PR:**
  - `git log --diff-filter=D -1 --format='%H%x09%s' "${_mdd_merge_base}..MERGE_HEAD" -- "$path"`.
  - The subject must match `\(#([0-9]+)\)$`. If it does not, skip with `reason=no_pr_number`.
- **Containment test:** the work goes in one inline `python3 -c` (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONSAFEPATH=1), fed with `git diff -U0 --no-color --no-ext-diff`:
  - Gather the PR's changed lines to the path (`+`/`-` lines, excluding `+++`/`---`). Zero lines skips with `reason=no_pr_change`; a binary diff skips with `reason=binary`; more than the cap skips with `reason=too_large`.
  - Normalise each line: keep its `+`/`-` sign, strip leading and trailing whitespace, and remove every occurrence of the path string.
  - "Other surviving files" are `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "${_mdd_merge_base}" HEAD`, minus the path itself, minus every allowlist path that is currently `1 2`.
  - Every non-blank normalised line must appear, with the same sign, among the normalised changed lines of at least one other surviving file. There must be at least one non-blank line. Otherwise skip with `reason=not_a_sweep`.
- **When both hold:**
  - `git rm -q -- "$path"`, then confirm `git ls-files -u -- "$path"` is empty (otherwise `::error::` and `exit 1`, matching the .ai asset block).
  - Append `path<TAB>#N<TAB>k` to `RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE` (default `${RUNTIME_DIR}/resolver_dropped_edits.tsv`).
  - Append a section to `${RUNTIME_DIR}/modify_delete_take_base_comment.md`: the path, "deleted on `<base>` by #N", and the first 10 lines of `git diff merge-base HEAD -- path` inside a dynamically sized fence. Reuse the `_ai_fence_len` technique; the total is capped at 61440 bytes.
  - Log `Modify/delete take-base: path=<p|redacted> deleted_by=#<n> pr_lines=<k>`. Skips log `Modify/delete take-base: path=<p|redacted> outcome=skip reason=<token>`.
- **After the loop**, if anything was taken:
  - Prepend `<!-- ai:modify-delete-take-base:v1 pr=<n> head=<sha> -->` plus a heading and intro paragraph to the comment file.
  - Recompute `RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE` and `_resolver_allowlist_count`, as the folded-fragment block does.
  - Set `_mdd_resolved=true`, and set `_mdd_defer_commit=true` when the count is 0. The block never commits inline: `_conflict_prepare_commit_deterministic_merge` is defined later in the file, and `tests/test_conflict_folded_fragment_keep.py::_block()` extracts a range that will now include this block.
- **Commit tail** (around :1186-:1245): after the `.ai asset` deferral and before the criss-cross block, add a branch for `_resolver_allowlist_count -eq 0` with `_mdd_defer_commit=true` and no other deferral:
  - On `orchestrator/project-*`: set `_mu_defer_commit=true`, `_det_commit_label="Modify/delete take-base"`, `_det_commit_scope="modify-delete-only"` and `_det_commit_path` (the taken paths). The existing integration fingerprint gate and deferred commit at around :1884 then run.
  - Otherwise: call `_conflict_prepare_commit_deterministic_merge "Modify/delete take-base"`.
- **Posting the comment:** add `_conflict_prepare_post_modify_delete_comment`, same shape as `_conflict_prepare_post_ai_asset_comment`: fail-open, renames to `.posted`, opening brace on a new line. Call it after `git commit` inside `_conflict_prepare_commit_deterministic_merge` and in the deferred tail next to the existing `_conflict_prepare_post_ai_asset_comment` call, each guarded by `type ... >/dev/null 2>&1`.

### 2. `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`: stage context, in-loop `unmerged_left`, explicit keep
- **Top-level defaults** near `RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_RETRY_MAX` (around :728):
  - Parse `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED` the same way into `_resolver_mdd_enabled`.
  - Define `RESOLVER_MODIFY_DELETE_PATHS_FILE`, `RESOLVER_UNMERGED_LEFT_FILE`, `RESOLVER_UNMERGED_LEFT_BASELINE_FILE` and `RESOLVER_MODIFY_DELETE_KEEP_FILE` under `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- **`_resolver_modify_delete_context()`** (new). Call it once right after `RESOLVER_TARGETED_PATHS_FILE` is built, next to `_capture_resolution_provenance_stages` (around :3884). When enabled, for each targeted path with stages exactly `1 2` or `1 3`:
  - Record `path<TAB>stages` in `RESOLVER_MODIFY_DELETE_PATHS_FILE`.
  - Find the deleting commit on the deleting side (`merge-base..MERGE_HEAD` for `1 2`, `merge-base..HEAD` for `1 3`) and its `(#N)`, which falls back to the short SHA, then to "unknown".
  - Append a block to `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PROMPT_FILE` titled `Modify/delete conflicts (stage context)`. Per path it says: "deleted on base by #N / modified on this PR" (or the reverse for `1 3`); that the surviving side's content is at `<path>` in the working tree; and the instruction:
    - to accept the deletion, delete the file (the runner stages this as `git rm`);
    - to keep it, leave or edit the file, and list its exact path under `Conflicts resolved:` in the final output.
  - Log `Modify/delete context: path=<p|redacted> stages=<s> deleted_by=<#n|commit|unknown>`.
  - Because the block is appended to the rendered prompt, it reaches both the generic and the integration-sync prompts.
